sections.name: IT4IT tools
sections.intro: Management tools for running IT, grouped by capability and mapped to the IT4IT value streams.

subs.name: Enterprise Architecture & Product Portfolio
subs.desc: Models business capabilities, applications and technology, and maintains architecture roadmaps and digital product portfolios.

subs.name: Strategic Portfolio, Demand & Value Streams
subs.desc: Prioritizes demand and investment, manages delivery portfolios, and links work to product outcomes.

subs.name: Development, DevOps & Quality
subs.desc: Source control, development, builds, CI, testing and delivery toolchains.

subs.name: Low-code Application Development
subs.desc: Builds applications and service workflows with visual models and reusable components.

subs.name: API Management & Integration
subs.desc: Develops, publishes and manages APIs, and connects applications through integration, messaging and orchestration.

subs.name: IT Service Management & Support
subs.desc: Incidents, problems, changes, requests, service catalogs, knowledge and service levels.

subs.name: IT Assets, Software & Configuration
subs.desc: Discovers and manages technology assets, software licenses, configuration records and lifecycle data.
subs.streams: Plan, Deliver, Run · Evaluate, Consume, Operate

subs.name: Endpoint Management & Employee Experience
subs.desc: Provisions, configures and patches employee devices, measures experience, and automates remediation.

subs.name: Observability, Events & AIOps
subs.desc: Monitors applications and infrastructure through metrics, logs, traces, events and correlation.

subs.name: Backup & Disaster Recovery
subs.desc: Protects data and workloads and coordinates restore, replication, failover and recovery testing.

subs.name: Deployment, Configuration & Workload Automation
subs.desc: Automates provisioning, infrastructure configuration, deployment and workload execution.
subs.streams: Build, Deliver, Run · Deploy, Release, Operate

subs.name: Vulnerability & Exposure Management
subs.desc: Finds weaknesses, assesses attack surfaces and prioritizes remediation.
subs.streams: Build, Run, Supporting · Integrate, Deploy, Operate

subs.name: Security Protection, Detection & Response
subs.desc: Protects endpoints, networks, email, cloud and data; detects threats; coordinates response.

subs.name: Identity, Access & Secrets Management
subs.desc: Manages identities, authentication, entitlements, privileged access and secrets.

subs.name: Data Center Infrastructure Management
subs.desc: Manages racks, equipment, space, connectivity and physical capacity.

subs.name: Network & Storage Management
subs.desc: Administers, configures and monitors network and storage infrastructure and capacity.

subs.name: Power & Cooling Management
subs.desc: Manages facility electrical capacity, power distribution, energy and cooling.

subs.name: IT Financial Management, TBM & FinOps
subs.desc: Manages technology budgets, costs, allocation, chargeback and cloud financial optimization.

subs.name: Technology Vendor & Contract Management
subs.desc: Manages technology suppliers, software procurement, subscriptions, renewals and contracts.

subs.name: Technology Governance, Risk & Compliance
subs.desc: Governs technology controls, cyber risk, audit evidence and policy compliance.

sections.name: Business applications
sections.intro: Applications that run the business, classified with the TBM 5 business categories, and the workplace platforms people use to communicate, collaborate and share knowledge.

subs.name: Product Management
subs.desc: Plans and develops customer-facing products and manages their lifecycles.

subs.name: Sales & Marketing
subs.desc: Customer analytics, commerce, marketing, advertising, sales and channel management.

subs.name: Manufacturing & Delivery
subs.desc: Production, inventory, logistics, resource planning and delivery.

subs.name: Customer Service
subs.desc: Customer care and order management across service and transaction lifecycles.

subs.name: Finance
subs.desc: Enterprise accounting, financial planning, revenue, payroll, payments, treasury and tax.

subs.name: Workforce
subs.desc: Recruitment, employee records, transitions, benefits, development, performance and workforce relations.

subs.name: Vendor & Procurement
subs.desc: Sourcing, purchasing, supplier relationships and contract lifecycle management.

subs.name: Health, Safety, and Environmental
subs.desc: Health, occupational safety and environmental policies and obligations.

subs.name: Risk, Audit & Compliance
subs.desc: Enterprise risk, audits, investigations, records, breach remediation and business continuity.

subs.name: Legal
subs.desc: Legal counsel, matters and cases, litigation, intellectual property and contract review.

subs.name: Property & Facility
subs.desc: Property, space planning, physical security, facilities maintenance and non-logistics fleet management.

subs.name: Corporate Communications
subs.desc: Stakeholder, government, media and community communications.

subs.name: Communication & Collaboration
subs.desc: Team messaging, meetings, email, intranets and employee communication.

subs.name: Content, Documents & Knowledge
subs.desc: Document, record, archive, enterprise content and knowledge management.

sections.name: Technology platforms
sections.intro: Databases, middleware, compute, data and AI platforms that applications run on.

subs.name: Relational Database Management Systems
subs.desc: Structured data in related tables, SQL queries and transactions.

subs.name: NoSQL & Document Databases
subs.desc: Document, wide-column and other non-relational engines.

subs.name: Web Servers & Reverse Proxies
subs.desc: Serves web content, terminates TLS, proxies traffic and routes requests.

subs.name: Application Servers & Runtimes
subs.desc: Runs application code and provides sessions, transactions, pooling and enterprise Java APIs.

subs.name: Communication & Messaging Servers
subs.desc: Message brokers, queues, event streaming and email servers.

subs.name: Integration Servers & iPaaS
subs.desc: Integration servers, ESBs and cloud integration platforms.

subs.name: API Gateways & Service Connectivity
subs.desc: Publishes, routes, secures and governs service interfaces.

subs.name: Caches & In-memory Data Stores
subs.desc: Shared in-memory stores and caches for fast access and temporary state.

subs.name: Managed File Transfer
subs.desc: Secure, automated file exchange between organizations and systems.

subs.name: Compute, Cloud & Container Platforms
subs.desc: General compute, cloud, container and application foundation platforms.

subs.name: Data Platforms & Governance
subs.desc: Warehouses, lakehouses, integration, master data, quality and metadata.

subs.name: Business Intelligence & Analytics
subs.desc: Reporting, visualization and analytical exploration.

subs.name: Data Science & Machine Learning Platforms
subs.desc: Model development, experimentation, deployment and ML environments.

subs.name: Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation
subs.desc: Agents and process automation executing workflows.

subs.name: Generative AI & Assistants
subs.desc: Generates text, code, images, audio or other content.

subs.name: Conversational & Interpretive AI
subs.desc: Language, document, image and speech understanding, chat and enterprise AI search.

subs.name: Predictive AI
subs.desc: Prediction and forecasting services and model platforms.

subs.name: Prescriptive AI & Optimization
subs.desc: Decision optimization, planning and recommendations.

subs.name: AI Development & Model Platforms
subs.desc: Training, serving, orchestration and lifecycle platforms where no narrower AI type applies.
